entries.def:
ἀπο-φορτίζομαι
(φορτίζω, to load), 
to discharge a cargo (Field, Notes, 134), to unlade: with accusative, τ. γόμον, Act.21.3.†
(AS)

ἀπό-χρησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποχράομαι, to use to the full, abuse) 
abuse, misuse: Col.2.22 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

ἀπο-χωρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Jer.46.5 (סוּג), 2Ma.4.33, 3Ma.2.33 * ;] 
to go away, depart, withdraw: before ἀπό, Mat.7.23, Luk.9.39, Act.13.13 (absol., Luk.20.20, Tr., mg.).†
(AS)

ἀπο-χωρίζω 
[in LXX: Ezk.43.21 (מִפְקָד)* ;] 
to separate, part asunder: pass., Rev.6.14 reflexively, to separate oneself: Act.15.39.†
(AS)

ἀπο-ψύχω 
[in LXX: 4Ma.15.18 * ;] 
__1. to breathe out life, expire (Thue.; LXX, l.with). 
__2. to leave off breathing, faint (Hom., Od., xxiv, 348): before ἀπό, Luk.21.26.†
(AS)

Ἀππιος, -ου, ὁ 
Appius; Ἀππίου Φόρον, Appii Forum (Market of Appius), a town in Italy: Act.28.15.†
(AS)

ἀ-πρόσ-ιτος, -ον
(πρόσειμι, to go to), 
unapproachable: φῶς, 1Ti.6.16.†
(AS)

ἀπρόσκοπος, -ον
(προσκόπτω), [in LXX: Sir.32.21, 3Ma.3.8 * ;] 
__1. act., not causing to stumble: metaphorically, of not leading others into sin, 1Co.10.32. 
__2. Pass., not stumbling, without offence, blameless: Act.24.16, Php.1.10 (for exx., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

ἀπροσωπολήμπτως (Rec. -λήπτως, cl.), adv. 
(α- neg., προσωπολήμπτης), 
without respect of persons, impartially: 1Pe.1.17.†
(AS)

ἄ-πταιστος, -ον
(πταίω), [in LXX: 3Ma.6.39 * ;] 
without stumbling, sure-footed: metaphorically (MM, see word), Jude.24.†
(AS)
